ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.
   D. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

3. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   B. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   B. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   B. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).

14. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   D. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Nullifiers of Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues Generosity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam Evils of Gambling 02 5.4 Dua Dua on Increase in Knowledge  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
